card.title: Believe This with Me
card.instruction: Recruit someone into treating your impossible explanation as the most useful version of events.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The house is migrating south. Help me redirect it before we lose the driveway.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The surveyor says subsidence. He's bringing concrete.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Concrete traps it halfway across the road. Tell him we're planning a route.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: His truck's blocking the road already.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect. Ask him to lead slowly toward the empty plot. It needs a guide.

mechanism: A recruits B to act on a migrating-house explanation because it offers a practical route out of the perceived danger.
confusable: Unlike merely announcing a fantasy, A must obtain actions that treat the explanation as useful.
comparison: A surveyor's obstructing truck becomes a guide, while the kettle scene turns a repair failure into labor negotiation.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
